provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.ar: اللغة والاتجاه معلنان على الجذر وعلى كل نطاق مختلف
title.en: Language and direction are declared on the root and on every scope that differs

statement.ar: العنصر الجذر يحمل lang وdir. كل مقطع بلغة أخرى (كلمة إنجليزية، اسم لاتيني، اقتباس) يحمل lang الخاص به، ومعه dir إن اختلف الاتجاه. الاتجاه لا يُستنتج من اللغة ولا العكس.
statement.en: The root element carries lang and dir. Every passage in another language (an English word, a Latin name, a quotation) carries its own lang, and dir too if the direction differs. Direction is not inferred from language, nor the reverse.

rationale.ar: قارئ الشاشة يختار صوت النطق من lang؛ دونها تُقرأ الإنجليزية بصوت عربي حرفًا حرفًا أو تُتخطى. والمتصفح يختار الخط وقواعد الكسر والتدقيق من اللغة.
rationale.en: A screen reader chooses its voice from lang; without it English is spelled out by an Arabic voice or skipped. The browser chooses font, line-breaking and spellchecking from the language.

checks: The html element has a valid BCP 47 lang and a dir attribute.
Every locale scope element sets lang and dir together.
Runs of four or more Latin letters forming words inside lang="ar" content are wrapped in an element with a non-Arabic lang, or listed as proper names exempt under 3.1.2.
Portaled content carries the lang and dir of its trigger scope.
